name: Kepler-411
description: Star of 4,837 K, 154 parsecs away, with 2 transiting planets.

radius.source: Sun et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-411 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Sun et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-411 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: TICv8, the stellar temperature of Kepler-411 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: 2 planets cross Kepler-411 as seen from Earth: c, d.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Sun et al. 2019, and its temperature TICv8.

quotes.title: Kepler-411
quotes.card: Kepler-411 is a binary star system.
quotes.introduction: Its primary star Kepler-411A is a K-type main-sequence star, orbited by the red dwarf star Kepler-411B on a wide orbit, discovered in 2012.

notes: Kepler-411 b: Sun et al. 2019's mass 0.0805462 Jupiter masses in 0.21420287 Jupiter radii is 10.2 g/cm^3, outside what the records accept

Kepler-411 e: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by transit timing variations)
